about: The 6 String Creative Blog is where we share what we are learning while helping small businesses grow. Expect practical, honest advice you can act on this week.
The weekly articles also follow Marketing Tune-Up, our short podcast. Dan and Kate host it. Each post stands on its own, so you can use the advice even if you never press play.
6 String Creative is a small, relationship-driven team in Greenwood, Indiana. We help local businesses with web design, social media, Google Business Profile, reviews, and local SEO.
footer_blurb: You don't need another marketing task on your plate. You need a trusted partner and a clear plan that helps your business grow with confidence and consistency.
